title: When grouped task popup becomes scrollable, remove side/top paddings to improve Fitts' Law adherence
line: Scrolling a long grouped task tooltip now also works with the pointer on its outer edges.
explanation: Task manager tooltips are drawn inside a frame whose padding (a few pixels on every side) has no item under it, so wheel events there went nowhere and a scrollable grouped tooltip could not be scrolled with the pointer on its edges. The old PlasmaQuick::Dialog forwarded wheel and mouse events from its padding into the content for exactly this Fitts' law reason, but ToolTipDialog lost that when it was moved to PopupPlasmaWindow. ToolTipDialog now moves a wheel event that lands on the padding to the nearest point inside the content and delivers it there, so the list scrolls from any point of the tooltip.

commits.message:
ToolTipDialog: scroll the content when the wheel is over the padding

Tooltips lost Dialog's forwarding of wheel events from the frame padding
to the content when they moved to PopupPlasmaWindow, so a long grouped
task tooltip couldn't be scrolled at its edges. Forward them again.

BUG: 493016

media.caption: Master: three wheel notches with the pointer on the tooltip's top edge (red ring) do nothing.
Fixed: the same wheel on the top edge scrolls the windows list.
Master: wheel on the left edge does nothing.
Fixed: wheel on the left edge scrolls the list.
